arguments.body:
Historical note — November 22, 2023

**Support-quality improvement observed:** Across 24 manually reviewed November invitations, 19 were accepted; 13 confirmed admin ownership and 6 were routed to Customer Success before setup. Nine workspaces were created and eight reached first integration. Admitted-account support load was lower than in the August and September beta shapes, particularly around billing and import handoffs.

**Issue still requiring monitoring:** Admin ownership had improved, but was not solved. The shared-agency admin case remained a warning that ownership proof and routing needed continued scrutiny.

**Boundary at the time:** The read was sufficient to prepare January readiness questions only. It did not change Q4 exposure or establish a launch, general-availability, pricing-page, paid-acquisition, pipeline, or revenue-credit decision; not all risks were resolved.
